svg.title: Elements
svg.desc: The 118 elements as bare squares, at rest in the conventional periodic table. They travel on straight paths into Janet's left-step form, then into the 32-column long form, then a Benfey-inspired spiral, then home again in a twelve-second cycle. The spiral pulls back to fit the frame, with a longer pause to read its loops. Each move takes about half a second and each shape holds long enough to read. While a move is under way a red thread runs through the squares in atomic-number order and then fades, showing where the new arrangement disagrees with the old.
